body.p: The present application includes pending claims 8-15, 17-30 and 32-37. Claims 8- 15, 17-30 and 32-37 have been rejected. The Office Action of April 17, 2023 ("OA") has been carefully considered.

The Applicant respectfully traverses the above rejections at least for the reasons previously set forth during prosecution and at least based on the following remarks. Reconsideration and allowance of the claims in view of the following remarks are respectfully requested.

Claims 8-15, 17-30, and 32-37 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being allegedly anticipated by Alden (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2004/0198436) further in view of McLoone (U.S. Patent No. 8,064,972) in further view of Applicant Admitted Prior Art (AAPA).

Regarding claim 8, the OA does not identify "a signal processor configured to selectively manage the communication of the game signal, the chat signal, the microphone signal and the external audio signal." Regarding claims 23, the OA does not identify "selectively managing, via a signal processor and an RF circuit, the communication of a game signal, a chat signal, a microphone signal and an external audio signal." Alden only refers to listening to music or other audible media while monitoring for a phone call, which is not equivalent to the aforementioned claim limitations. McLoone only refers to an alleged chat signal, an alleged microphone signal and an alleged external audio signal. The OA admits that Alden and McLoone are deficient for at least these reasons.

In an attempt to show "a signal processor configured to selectively manage the communication of the game signal, the chat signal, the microphone signal and the external audio signal" as claimed, the OA cites that the AAPA and states, "[t]he that game sounds and chat sounds are separately adjustable so as to allow them to be balanced

However, the AAPA does not teach "a signal processor configured to selectively manage the communication of the game signal" with or without the chat signal. Rather, the XboxTM game sound signal, at the time this application was filed, would have been separately adjustable via a manual TV/monitor volume control. In fact, the ability for the XboxTM console (alleged signal processor) to directly control/manage the game sound signal from a TV/monitor is a feature that was made available, only recently, with the XboxTM console update in October 2022. https://www.makeuseof.com/how-to-control-tv- volume-with-xbox-series-x-s/ Therefore, the ability to selectively manage the game sound signal in combination with the additional audio signals via the XboxTM console (alleged signal processor) would NOT have been understood as being implicit based on the AAPA at the time this application was filed.

Because the OA fails show "selectively managing, via a signal processor and an RF circuit, the communication of a game signal, a chat signal, a microphone signal and an external audio signal" as claimed, a prima facie case of obviousness has not been provided.
For at least the aforementioned reasons, claims 8-15, 17-30 and 32-37 are allowable.

The Office Action makes various statements, including without limitation statements regarding the claims, 35 U.S.C. § 103, the cited references, one of ordinary skill in the art, etc., that are now moot in view of the previously presented amendments and/or arguments. Thus, the Applicant will not address all of such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by reappearing in a rejection of any current or future claim or be relied upon in any proceeding involving this application or a corresponding patent). The Applicant also respectfully reserves the
right to argue additional reasons that support the allowability of all claims, whether or not argued in this Response or previous responses, should that need arise in the future.

The Applicant submits that the pending claims are in condition for allowance and courteously solicits an expeditious Notice of Allowability with respect to all pending claims. If the Examiner has any questions or the Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.
The Commissioner is authorized to charge any necessary fees, or credit any overpayment to the Deposit Account of McAndrews, Held & Malloy, Account No. 13- 0017.
